title: DART-Q : A Deadline-Driven Framework for Real-Time QLDPC Decoding
summary: Real-time quantum error correction places the classical decoder inside the fault-tolerant control loop under strict timing and memory constraints. For quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes, practical deployment therefore depends not only on correction performance, but also on timely decoding under deadlines, finite on-chip memory, and time-varying load. However, existing decoder studies primarily emphasize correction performance without exposing operational viability under these constraints.
